title: Batched push payload has no defined shape
description: Line 171 says servers MAY deliver 'a single push payload containing an array of ChatMessagePush objects' but the example shows a bare object. The batched form is undefined — is it [{...},{...}] or a wrapper object? The @type pattern breaks if the payload is an array. Must define a wrapper type (e.g. ChatMessagePushBatch) or specify the array envelope.
